selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Why did the two men go on a trip?
questions.answer: For enjoyment and for work.

questions.question: How does the passage help readers understand this idea?
questions.answer: By telling a story that compares two men.

questions.question: What did he believe about the whole country?
questions.answer: That it was like one huge mourning place.

questions.question: What good qualities did the second man have?
questions.answer: Faith, devotion, fairness, and good manners.

questions.question: Which words of faith did he hear in the celebrations?
questions.answer: He heard “Allah is Most Great” and that only Allah is God.

questions.question: Besides being happy, what useful thing did he do?
questions.answer: He made good business.

questions.question: What did he hear when duties ended?
questions.answer: Happy good wishes and thanks.

questions.question: What happened after the first man listened?
questions.answer: He recovered and repented.

questions.question: In the story, how many travelers are there?
questions.answer: Two.

questions.question: How did the selfish man see the country around him?
questions.answer: He thought it was sad, scary, and full of trouble.

questions.question: What was the second man’s direction like?
questions.answer: It was godly and blessed.

questions.question: Which traveler had better character?
questions.answer: The godly traveler.

questions.question: Why is the first traveler called miserable in the story?
questions.answer: Because his way of seeing brought him pain.

questions.question: What made the land feel joyful to him?
questions.answer: Celebration, remembrance of Allah, and happy voices.

questions.question: When the second man met the first man again, what did he say was the problem?
questions.answer: He said the bad picture came from the first man’s inner state.

questions.question: What two things did he gain on the journey?
questions.answer: Happiness and profit.

questions.question: What big idea does this passage teach about belief in Allah?
questions.answer: It teaches that belief brings joy, comfort, and blessing.

questions.question: Why did the selfish man end up seeing the place as evil?
questions.answer: Because his outlook was dark and negative.

questions.question: How did he feel about other people?
questions.answer: He felt they were strangers and enemies.

questions.question: What did he notice happening across the country?
questions.answer: He noticed happy gatherings and remembrance of Allah.

questions.question: What was wrong with the first traveler’s way of thinking?
questions.answer: He was proud, self-centered, and gloomy.

questions.question: What kind of person was the second man on the inside?
questions.answer: He was a believer with good manners and a fair heart.

questions.question: What did he hear when people started serving?
questions.answer: Music, praise of Allah, and words of faith.

questions.question: What did the second man tell him to do first to see the truth?
questions.answer: Clean his heart.
